name: Long-run survival & progress maturity: crash-bundle forensics, bit-idempotent resume, budgeted progress metering, four-rung stall ladder, honest FAIL, memory-cap degradation

job_config.description: generic job config (grid/steps/checkpoint_every/seed plus optional crash injection)

events.description: artifact names+digests, criterion evaluations, measured information gain (bits)

memory_cap.description: cap and measured RSS used by the degradation decision

crash_bundle.description: artifacts/crash_<stamp>/ with siginfo, registers, stack, mappings, manifest, SHA256SUMS, digest

progress_report.description: credits, budget_used, progress_rate, criteria, info gain, manual recount

stall_report.description: detection position, four-rung ladder events, recoveries, append-only strategy blacklist

fail_record.description: FAIL.json/FAIL.md with reason and the retained artifact digests (retention floor enforced)

degradation_report.description: decision (threads/chunk), full-grid admissibility probe, peak RSS, relative L2 error

applicability.regime: generic long-running compute jobs (>30 min): crash autopsy, resume after a fatal signal, stall/reroute policy, honest abort, memory-capped execution; domain-agnostic by construction

a1_bundle_verify_ok.source: SHA256SUMS re-verified after copying the bundle

a2_resume_bit_identical.source: sha256 of resumed final state == uninterrupted final state

a3_progress_rate_relative_error.source: meter rate vs recount from artifacts on disk + external step counter

a4_first_detection_budget_fraction.source: first stall detection position as a fraction of the budget

a5_post_reroute_artifacts.source: artifacts emitted after the reroute action (threshold >= 1)

a6_retention_vs_produced.source: retained / produced artifacts at honest-FAIL time

a7_full_run_equals_bare_job.source: digest of the survival-layer full run vs the bare stepped job

a8_false_positive_stalls.source: stall events on steady (5 %) and bursty (20 %) producers

a9_distinct_resume_digests.source: distinct final digests across three idempotent resumes

a10_degraded_rel_error.source: streamed single-thread field vs full-grid float64 reference (relative L2)

a10_threads_after_decision.source: threads chosen by decide() under the memory cap

validation_evidence.relative_error_source: bit-level identities (sha256 equality for resume/negative control) and measured recount/relative-L2 errors; all numerical criteria are below 3 %
validation_evidence.verification_status_note: 10/10 criteria pass; A2/A7 digests equal at bit level, A3 relative error 1.122e-16, A10 relative error 4.340e-16 under a 100663296 B cap with threads=1

failure_modes.symptom: the process keeps consuming budget while emitting no artifact or passing no criterion; wall-clock liveness probes and heartbeats stay green, so the budget is burnt silently
failure_modes.mitigation: progress is credited only against durable artifacts / passed criteria / measured information gain, and the stall detector fires on a budget-normalised barren window

failure_modes.mode: careless reroute without a declared alternative
failure_modes.symptom: on a stall the agent improvises a new plan; the switch is unauditable and can loop back to the strategy that already starved
failure_modes.mitigation: strategies are declared up-front in an ordered plan; a barren one is appended to an append-only blacklist that next() never returns

failure_modes.symptom: a run declares itself failed and stops, having discarded or never flushed partial artifacts, so the burnt budget yields nothing reusable
failure_modes.mitigation: the live state is flushed as a final artifact before FAIL, and HonestFail.write() raises unless retention_vs_produced >= 0.5

failure_modes.symptom: a stack dump is written but nothing proves it belongs to this run or was not edited afterwards; register files are regularly truncated to fewer than five fields
failure_modes.mitigation: every file is hashed into SHA256SUMS, digest.json recomputes a location-independent bundle digest, registers.json records n_fields and an explicit sufficient flag

failure_modes.mode: emulated memory cap mistaken for a cgroup
failure_modes.symptom: the cap is enforced by an in-process allocator, so the reported peak RSS can exceed the cap (interpreter and library overhead is not part of the projection)
failure_modes.mitigation: documented as a projection budget; both numbers (projected bytes and real VmHWM) are reported side by side and never conflated
